Image 2 is a reference ONLY for the earrings' ornamental language; do not include its person, face, hair, clothing or human anatomy. Image 3 is a reference ONLY for realistic hanging construction, white wall, framing and soft light; do not copy its coat into other garments.
GARMENT: The long black double-breasted cashmere coat. Preserve exactly eight silver shark-tooth fasteners in four pairs, notched lapels, turned-back cuffs, side pockets and long straight hem. Support the shoulders on a broad, slim dark walnut clothes hanger.
DISPLAY HARDWARE: Replace the plain silver wall fitting of Image 3 with a SMALL, exquisite structural wall hook inspired by the earrings in Image 2: patinated dark antique-gold filigree, one deep ruby-red oval stone, one smaller black stone above it, one tiny pearl-drop finial. This is restrained couture display hardware, not a giant earring or ornate picture frame. Keep it compact, about 8% of garment height. A solid antique-gold hook projects from the ornamental wall backplate and securely holds the hanger's hook. The gemstone and pearl are decorative, not load-bearing. Use finely grained dark chocolate walnut for the actual hanger, visibly peeking through the neckline. No large wooden plaque or wooden wall.
REAL PHYSICS: Show a continuous credible support chain: white wall -> fixed ornate hook -> hanger -> garment. Clothing rests on actual support points and drops vertically under gravity, with relaxed fabric and subtle asymmetric folds. No ghost mannequin, no filled body, no unsupported floating object, no CSS-like rotated image, no wind, no flying sleeves. Preserve all actual garment construction and signature details.
SCENE: Entire garment, hanger AND wall fixture inside a near-orthographic, straight-on portrait 2:3 frame. Combined installation occupies around 85% of height, comfortable margins all around. Matte white gallery wall, edges almost pure white so the photo blends into a white webpage. Soft upper-left daylight and a restrained, physically credible shadow just behind and slightly right of the garment. Keep the photograph quiet and expensive, textile details legible, deep black materials still black. Same framing/lighting/hardware family across the collection.
EXCLUDE: people, mannequins, skin, models, hands, visible wires, floor, baseboard, room furniture, logos, text, borders, vignette, dramatic spotlights, unrelated garments or extra ornaments.

revisions.prompt:
Make a precise physical-drape correction to this existing Siren gown wall-display image. Preserve the exact white wall, small antique-gold filigree ruby-red/black/pearl wall hook, dark walnut hanger, lighting, camera, original pink/mint lace colors and gown construction. The dress is EMPTY and hangs from its halter strap, not on an invisible mannequin.
CHANGE ONLY the cloth's hanging pose: collapse the inflated rounded hips and bust into soft inward vertical folds, retaining the recognizable sewn design and neckline. Most importantly, the long train must hang DOWN freely in soft vertical pleats and narrow layered folds. It must NOT spread horizontally on an invisible floor and must NOT have a floor contact shadow. There is no floor in this image. Let the original wide lace train gather and hang under gravity, with the complete lace hem clearly visible and at least 5% clear wall margin beneath. The supporting walnut hanger and ornament remain exactly as in the supplied image. Natural shadow falls onto the vertical white wall behind the gown. Full installation in frame, physically believable hanging empty couture dress. No person or mannequin, no extra supports, no new straps, no text.
revisions.reason: Let the train hang vertically and remove the implied floor and filled torso.
